item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem:
In her school science laboratory, Anjali beats a thin copper strip with a hammer. The copper strip ……1……, so copper is said to be malleable.

She then beats a piece of sulfur with the same hammer. The sulfur ……2……, so sulfur is said to be brittle.

Which words correctly complete gaps 1 and 2?

options.A: 1 flattens into a sheet; 2 flattens into a sheet
options.B: 1 flattens into a sheet; 2 breaks into pieces
options.C: 1 breaks into pieces; 2 flattens into a sheet
options.D: 1 breaks into pieces; 2 breaks into pieces
